title: Cleaning Up a Biohazardous Spill Inside a Centrifuge
author: Steven W Wilhelm
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.wgkfbuw
materials: Wait 00:30:00 to allow the aerosols to settle.
Segregate contaminated cleanup materials into the appropriate biohazardous waste containers.

steps.title: Isolate area and settle aerosols
steps.instruction: Close off the area surrounding the centrifuge and wait for aerosols to settle before proceeding.

steps.title: Don personal protective equipment
steps.instruction: Wear a laboratory coat, safety glasses, and nitrile gloves.

steps.title: Remove rotor and bucket to BSC
steps.instruction: Take off the centrifuge rotor and bucket and place them inside a biosafety cabinet.

steps.title: Disinfect, rinse, and dry components
steps.instruction: Thoroughly disinfect the rotor, cups, and accessories, ensuring the disinfectant remains in contact for the proper time; then move the items to a sink, rinse them completely, and dry them thoroughly.

substeps.instruction: Disinfect rotor, cups, and accessories with appropriate disinfectant and allow proper contact time
Rinse disinfected items thoroughly in sink

steps.title: Clean centrifuge interior as outside BSC
steps.instruction: Clean the interior of the centrifuge by following the same procedure used for cleaning a spill outside a biosafety cabinet.
